summary_md: **Szymon Chmal ([@ChmalSzymon](https://x.com/ChmalSzymon/status/2116118360270495865))** introduces **Simlock**, a free open-source control plane that turns a machine into a self-managing simulator cloud so each parallel coding agent gets its own iOS/Android simulator or real phone ([callstackincubator/simlock](https://github.com/callstackincubator/simlock)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - callstackincubator/simlock: A control plane so parallel coding agents stop fighting over the same simulator.

relevance: Device isolation for parallel mobile coding agents.
